designation: PROPOSED SYNTHETIC APEX PERFORMANCE PROFILE — AWAITING PRIMARY ACCEPTANCE

coordinates.control_semantics: delta is front steering angle; a_cmd=Fx_total/m; dynamic dvx/dt=a_cmd+r*vy
coordinates.frame: world x/y in metres; headings radians counterclockwise; body vx forward, vy left, yaw r counterclockwise
coordinates.frenet: e_y left-positive; e_psi=body heading minus centerline tangent; s_abs nonnegative unwrapped centerline arc progress; track lookup s_abs modulo length
coordinates.angle_convention: (-pi,pi]; tracking/handoff residuals wrapped; NLP heading locally unwrapped for smooth derivatives

vehicle.identification: synthetic validation parameters; not physically identified
vehicle.rate_source: 1 rad/s from MPCConfig/TrackerConfig; fallback receives a replaced parameter object; YAML rate remains unknown

models.plant_integrator: existing RK4; all stages and final state checked; physical step split at events, at most 0.005 s
models.nmpc_integrator: existing symbolic RK4; 4 substeps of 0.025 s per interval; exogenous preview curvature held per interval
models.geometry: plant resamples track geometry at derivative states; predictor uses curvature sampled at each prediction segment start

planning.interpolation: periodic cubic geometry with serialized speed polynomial; no online reference regeneration
planning.pseudo_reference: vy_ref=0; r_ref=v_ref*kappa_ref; delta_ff=atan(wheelbase*kappa_ref); a_ref=0 because absent from this package
planning.warning_policy: advisory feasibility warnings are retained, not a guarantee of racing-reference dynamic realizability
planning.geometry_construction: ClosedTrack.from_waypoints; periodic cubic chord parameter, numerically integrated arc length and inverse queries; constructor source bound by inventory

nmpc.control_parameterization: full N-stage piecewise-constant two-input sequence; no separate shortened control-horizon parameter or move blocking

stage_cost.increment: u[k]-u[k-1], with predicted preceding command at k=0; no division by dt
stage_cost.sum_scaling: unweighted stage sum, no dt multiplier

terminal.policy: terminal multiplier times lateral DARE quadratic plus speed error weight 4; no terminal set or terminal equality
terminal.schedule: linear interpolation of P entries; clamp terminal preview speed to [1,3]
terminal.design_weights_definition: 1 / DesignScales**2; stored values retain binary floating evaluation; conceptually diag(100,100,4,1), R=25

constraints.box_tightening: also grip and minimum axle-load bounds; under this fixture they do not narrow [-3,2]
constraints.domain_checks: vx and Frenet denominator at nodes and all internal RK4 stages; load and longitudinal grip per input stage

solver.other_options: backend defaults of the locked CasADi distribution; no linear_solver override
solver.ipopt_standalone_version_reason: not independently recorded; no claim about unrecorded plugin build/linear-solver version
solver.acceptance: backend success, finite x/g and bound/constraint infeasibility <=1e-6; controller rechecks shape, finite values, g tolerance 1e-6 and variable bounds tolerance 1e-8
solver.acceptable_convergence: IPOPT normal acceptable_tol=1e-6 path remains; no custom early/suboptimal policy

warm_start.strategy: shift states/controls/slacks one stage; duplicate terminal column; replace first state with new predicted initial state
warm_start.on_failure: clear retained solution; next solve cold-starts; failure placeholder is not applied by trajectory planner
warm_start.cold_start: preview steering clipped/rate-limited, acceleration zero, symbolic propagation guess; finite/in-bound state fallback and geometric slacks

tracker.gain_policy: finite-horizon TVLQR along nominal packet at 0.01 s; Jacobians of symbolic RK4 with 2 substeps; final discrete DARE then backward Riccati recursion
tracker.longitudinal_feedback: a_nominal-speed_kp*(vx-vx_nominal); proportional only, no tracker PI integral
tracker.limits: box clip then nominal-tick steering slew; actual application additionally clamps by elapsed time since prior physical application

scheduling.policy: variable availability; no fixed deadline commitment
scheduling.prediction_target: t_release + RollingDelay.estimate(); packet nominal timeline begins at this target, not actual readiness

delay_estimator.observation: physical preparation delay on observed completion only; startup not observed; estimate cap does not bound solve duration

predictor.future_codriver_latency: ideal future feedback timing; skipped ticks and future actual computation durations unknown
predictor.target_horizon: reject beyond active trajectory; no future solver duration or plant truth

scheduling.startup: plan 0 prepared at simulated t=0, estimate=0; launch gated; first command prepositioned before motion with unmodelled prelaunch time

handoff.late_readiness: may accept if unexpired and valid, without shifting nominal timeline
handoff.checks: valid newer packet; completion and timeline available; wrapped continuity check; nominal plant validity; buffer trim at actual acceptance
handoff.authority: only accepted buffer packet; state interpolation and ZOH nominal controls/gains; never interpolate IDs or extrapolate expired authority

urgent.comparison: strict greater-than OR; trigger only at count==2; latch while busy
urgent.priority: nominal opportunity first; consumes urgent demand when serviced

scheduling.busy: single pending preparation; no overlap or cancellation; nominal busy misses recorded; TVLQR and plant continue while valid authority exists

event_order.action: Apply due old actuator request, elapsed steering clamp; preserve request plan_id/mode
Resolve due planner completion and observe elapsed delay; A accept/wait/reject; C readiness only
A waiting nominal start; C deadline acceptance/miss
Optional disturbance, then exhaustion eligibility/termination or fallback latch
Busy-tick handling or trajectory/fallback control computation and request validation
Nominal release priority, then eligible latched urgent release; no overlapping solve
Same-time zero-duration continuation, otherwise applied-pair diagnostics, recording and held-input RK4

scheduling.pending_control: retains original request packet provenance across handoff; held between actual applications; not erased on fallback entry
scheduling.readiness_error_limit: readiness-state mismatch is not aligned target-time prediction error

physical_validity.tire: smooth combined grip; proportional allocation; hard longitudinal validity, smooth lateral envelope

admission.geometry: track.sample(s_abs % track.length); CG point only; no 0.08 m margin or footprint shrink
not_checked_at: every actuator application as a separate fallback eligibility check
every RK4 stage against baseline speed/corridor domain

fallback.control: scheduled linear LQR plus SpeedPI kp=1 ki=0.5; separate from TVLQR

evaluation_protocol.scope: retained VIS evaluation conditions, not production/controller defaults
evaluation_protocol.measured_planner_delay: full measured TrajectoryPlanner.prepare wall duration; zero/injected modes remain generic implementation options
evaluation_protocol.startup_cost: prelaunch and distinct from runtime preparation distribution
scope_limits: one controlled A full lap and one measured A full lap
first crossing from rolling start is partial
center clearance is recorded CG clearance, not swept-body certification
Mac timing is descriptive, not embedded worst-case certification

provenance.identity_claim: current files listed in the 294-entry scientific inventory remain byte-identical; new E2 audit tools/configuration are not a new scientific executable test

environment.policy: fresh sequential process; environment(1) then configure_accelerate(1) before numerical imports; VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 and PYTHONHASHSEED=0; remove competing backend variables
environment.observation_limit: process threads sampled before/after preparation; exact continuously active BLAS count unavailable; empty threadpoolctl inventory is not proof of no backend
environment.lock_binding: uv.lock binds all platform resolutions and distribution hashes; recorded installed numerical versions identify tested arm64 environment; no environment reinstall during E2

verification.previous_evidence: inherited only for unchanged components; E0 applicability register remains authoritative; no count summation
